kind: numeric prediction scheduling and callback-state diagnostics; no audio or dialogue

method.stream_classification: maai callback with p_bc is primary Mimi; callback with p_now is CPC. Selected configs use bc or bc,bc_det plus separate CPC vap.
method.matching: lexicographically sorted trace files,55 per repetition, against55 sorted scenario IDs; every selected trace hash checked against the previously validated numeric artifact.
method.vad_now_s: floor(round(trace.audio_s*16000)/512)*512/16000; exact post-feed VAD window clock at on_maai callbacks, no model calls
method.freshness: now_s - last_delivered_stream_at_s <= config.maai_stale_s; combined stamp=min(last delivered primary,CPC)
method.masking_witness: callback-derived combined state stale, one individual stream fresh; last delivered frame replay, not actual worker latest() logging
method.conditional_boundary: for primary frame at_s=p, combined stamp cannot be fresh once VAD now_s>p+stale_s unless primary publishes a newer frame. First possible tick is(floor((p+stale_s)/.032)+1)*.032.
method.output_grid_gaps: missing slots between emitted callback at_s values,80ms Mimi or100ms CPC; may include dropped input and startup suppression after resets; excludes initial and final missing outputs.
limits: worker publishes _latest before scheduling the callback; delivered callbacks cannot prove actual latest() was stale or identify an exact actual masking onset
no per-worker drop or process/reset/publication timestamps exist; summed drops cannot be assigned exactly to streams
wall lag=t-at_s includes input receipt backlog,worker processing and callback delivery; not inference duration
CPC value classes on witness callbacks do not prove endpoint decisions changed; VAD silence eligibility and actual latest() selection are not logged
method.exact_clock_identity: trace.t - prediction.at_s = (trace.t - trace.audio_s) + (trace.audio_s - prediction.at_s). The first term includes clock-origin offset,receipt/event-loop delay; the second includes input queue/process age and unobserved callback publication/delivery behavior. Neither is pure inference duration.
